leadText: Mom (Japanese: おかあさん mother) is the mother of or and the wife of Norman.
plainText:
Mom (Japanese: おかあさん mother) is the mother of or and the wife of Norman.

==In the core series games==
In , , , the player and their mother finish their move to Littleroot Town in a moving truck. She instructs them to set the time on the clock upstairs and to make sure that everything is on their desk. When the player comes back downstairs, she will say that the player's father is on TV; however, the player just missed him.

When the player defeats Norman, she will give an Amulet Coin as a reward.

In Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire, after the player has entered the Hall of Fame, a news report will be on TV. It will announce that a Pokémon is the Hoenn region, which will be either or . In , it will not distinguish which of the eon duo is the roaming Pokémon, due to static interference. Instead, the player's mother will ask if the news report was either about a red creature (Latias) or a blue creature (Latios). The one chosen will then roam Hoenn. In Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, Latias or Latios is encountered earlier in the game and no longer roams. Instead, after completing the Delta Episode, she gives the player a Latiasite or Latiosite .

In , Norman reveals that he and his family moved to Hoenn from Olivine City.

===Items given===
 
 
 
 
 
 

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
In Pokémon Masters EX, she is 's wife and 's mother. She is not seen in-game, but she is mentioned in Brendan's dialogue.

==Gallery==
===Sprites and models===
 
 

==Quotes==
 

==In animation==
 
 
In , Caroline, and Max's mother, serves as her counterpart. She was introduced in There's no Place Like Hoenn and is married to Norman.
 

==In the manga==
 
 
===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
 's mother appears as a recurring character in this chapter. She and her son moved from Goldenrod City to Littleroot Town at the beginning of the chapter to live closer to her husband after he had been appointed as the Gym Leader of . She was left distraught after Ruby ran away from home soon after their arrival in order to participate in Pokémon Contests against his father's will.

===Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire===
Ruby's mother appeared at the beginning of Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire, fulfilling the same role from the games. She arrived in Littleroot Town with Ruby in a moving truck and started to unpack furniture with .
 

==Trivia==
In Pokemon Ruby and Sapphire, a non-player character in Petalburg City mentions that Norman and his family are from Johto. In Pokémon Emerald, the character who said this instead states that the player character's family moved from somewhere far away. In Pokémon Black 2 and White 2, Norman reveals that he is more specifically from Olivine City. In some new dialogue from Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, the player's Mom also mentions that they moved from Johto.
However, in the Pokémon Adventures manga, they are from Goldenrod City instead. This was introduced in the manga prior to the reveal that they are from Olivine City in the games.
